The 5 new large flow trades suggest institutional positioning changes, likely defensive given the CAG bull-delusion reading of 0.62. With VIX at 17.42 in a pinned volatility regime and positive GEX of $545M, markets are artificially suppressed but building tension. The champion 21d model turning bearish at 67% confidence while shorter timeframes remain bullish indicates underlying deterioration masked by gamma flows.
